name: Down Under Dogz

tenures.source: Named as a pairing by the promotion's own broadcast team ahead of a scheduled tag debut against Claw Richens and Long S. Tran on 24 December; the two also interfered together in the promotion's own first Intercontinental Championship match the same night.

caption: An Australian-billed pairing of "Down Under" Derek Davies and Alex "Alligator" McKay, named as a team the same night their scheduled tag debut went unrecorded.
